outcome: Placental growth factor (PlGF) levels in fetal circulation
Free beta human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-hCG) levels in fetal circulation
Pregnancy-associated plasma protein-A (PAPP-A) levels in fetal circulation
cohort: The study included 20 near-term pregnancies complicated with severe preeclampsia and 20 matched controls.
finding: Near-term severe preeclamptic pregnancies showed significantly lower PlGF levels and higher PAPP-A and free beta-hCG levels in the fetal circulation compared to controls.
gest_age: Near-term (cases and controls matched for gestational age)
